convert_metadata_to_beta: convert an iterable of metadata key-value pairs into a tuple of byte-encoded Metadatum objects
convert_beta_metadata_to_string: convert a tuple of byte-encoded Metadatum objects back into a tuple of string key-value pairs
encode_single_metadatum: encode a single metadata key-value pair into an ASCII byte-encoded Metadatum namedtuple
decode_single_metadatum: decode a single byte-encoded Metadatum namedtuple back into a string key-value pair with bin suffix handling
review_metadata_conversion: review the beta and unbeta metadata conversion utilities for gRPC API metadata handling
